hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Picture the sorted data split into four equal groups. Which part of the data does the IQR stretch across?
The IQR (interquartile range) is the distance between the two quartiles, the width of the middle half of the data.
Both quartiles are given, so subtract the lower one from the upper one: work out $11 - 3$.

explanation: The interquartile range measures the spread of the middle half of the data, from $Q1$ to $Q3$.
The problem gives both quartiles: $Q1 = 3$ and $Q3 = 11$.
Subtract the lower quartile from the upper quartile: $11 - 3 = 8$, so the IQR is $8$.
